headline: Israel says it has serious concerns with the White House's Hamas disarmament deal
context: President Trump announced a proposed disarmament deal with Hamas last week. Israeli strikes overnight and into Sunday evening killed at least 17 people, including children, in Gaza.

sources.name: NPR
